name: show_player_options
title: Player and joystick digits of the title

comments.text: When the options show, writes the number of players and of joysticks as two map cells each.
OPTION in the developer symbol table (symbol_table_leftover).
Digit 1 is $11. The right half of a character is the code plus $34.
EXIT in the developer symbol table (symbol_table_leftover).
